metaTitle: Land Rover Engine Machining | Land Rover Garage
metaDescription: Precision Land Rover engine machining services: cylinder boring, honing, crankshaft grinding, cylinder head resurfacing, and valve work. Part of every full engine rebuild.

sections.heading: What Land Rover Engine Machining Involves

blocks.html: Engine machining is a precision workshop process that restores critical engine components to factory tolerances. As part of every full engine rebuild we carry out, our in-house machine shop performs the following operations:

items: **Cylinder Boring & Honing** — worn bores are bored to an oversize and honed to a cross-hatch finish for optimal oil retention and piston seal.
**Crankshaft Grinding & Polishing** — main and big-end journals are ground undersize and polished to restore smooth running surfaces.
**Cylinder Head Resurfacing** — the head face is machined flat to ensure a perfect seal with the block.
**Valve Guide & Seat Work** — guides are replaced and seats recut for proper valve sealing.
**Pressure Testing & Crack Detection** — blocks and heads are tested for integrity before reassembly.

blocks.html: All machining is performed to manufacturer specifications using precision measuring equipment and industry-standard tolerances. The work is carried out on-site in our dedicated machine shop, not outsourced.

steps.title: Inspection & Measurement
steps.body: Every component is inspected and measured for wear, ovality, taper, and surface condition to determine the required machining.

steps.title: Cylinder Boring
steps.body: Worn bores are bored to an oversize dimension on our precision boring machine, matching the new oversize pistons.

steps.title: Cylinder Honing
steps.body: The bores are honed to final size with a cross-hatch pattern for oil retention, verified with bore gauges.

steps.title: Crankshaft Grinding & Polishing
steps.body: Main and big-end journals are ground undersize and polished to restore smooth surfaces, with new bearings sized accordingly.

steps.title: Cylinder Head Resurfacing
steps.body: The cylinder head face is machined flat to ensure a perfect seal with the block.

steps.title: Valve Guide & Seat Work
steps.body: Guides are replaced, seats recut, and valves refaced and lapped for proper sealing.

steps.title: Cleaning & Pressure Testing
steps.body: All components are ultrasonically cleaned, then pressure-tested and crack-detected to ensure integrity.

steps.title: Final Quality Control
steps.body: Every machined part is measured against specifications before being released for assembly.

items.q: Do you machine all Land Rover engine types?
items.a: Yes. We machine cast-iron and aluminium blocks across all Land Rover engine families, including classic Tdi/Td5, TDV6/SDV6, Ingenium diesel and petrol, AJ133 supercharged V8, and BMW-sourced V8s.

items.q: Is machining included in the quoted rebuild price?
items.a: Yes. All machining operations (boring, honing, grinding, resurfacing, valve work, and pressure testing) are included as standard in our fixed-price rebuild quotes. There are no hidden extras for machining.

items.q: How long does the machining process take?
items.a: Machining is integrated into our 3-5 working day rebuild turnaround. The machining itself typically takes 1-2 days, depending on the extent of work required.

items.q: Do you use new parts after machining?
items.a: Yes. We fit new oversize pistons and rings, undersize bearings, valve guides, and seals as needed. All parts are sourced from reputable suppliers and meet manufacturer specifications.

items.q: Can you machine an engine that has already been rebuilt elsewhere?
items.a: Yes, provided the engine is still serviceable. We assess the condition and can re-machine components if they are within tolerance limits. Contact us for an inspection.
